rationale.en: Forwarding also depends on applicable security policy.
rationale.fa: ارسال به سیاست امنیتی اعمال‌شده نیز وابسته است.
rationale.de: Weiterleitung hängt auch von der geltenden Sicherheitsrichtlinie ab.

text: A branch uses a static default through a directly adjacent ISP. What ARP entry is needed for an off-subnet IPv4 server packet on that Ethernet link?
options: The distant server's MAC address across the Internet
The DNS root server's MAC address

rationale.en: The Ethernet frame is addressed to the local next hop.
rationale.fa: فریم Ethernet به گام بعدی محلی آدرس‌دهی می‌شود.
rationale.de: Der Ethernet-Frame wird an den lokalen nächsten Hop adressiert.

text: Which routing protocol category describes OSPFv2?

rationale.en: OSPF distributes link-state information.
rationale.fa: OSPF اطلاعات وضعیت لینک را توزیع می‌کند.
rationale.de: OSPF verteilt Informationen zum Verbindungszustand.

text: Which algorithm does OSPF use to calculate shortest paths?

rationale.en: OSPF computes a shortest-path tree using SPF.
rationale.fa: OSPF درخت کوتاه‌ترین مسیر را با SPF محاسبه می‌کند.
rationale.de: OSPF berechnet mit SPF einen kürzesten Pfadbaum.

text: A lab is designed with one OSPF backbone area. Which area ID should its participating links use?

rationale.en: The OSPF backbone is area 0.
rationale.fa: ستون فقرات OSPF ناحیه 0 است.
rationale.de: Der OSPF-Backbone ist Bereich 0.

text: Which command starts IOS OSPF process 10?

rationale.en: router ospf selects a local process.
rationale.fa: router ospf فرایند محلی را انتخاب می‌کند.
rationale.de: router ospf wählt einen lokalen Prozess.

text: R1 uses OSPF process 1 and R2 uses process 20 on a shared area-0 link. Must their process IDs match?
options: Yes; they are transmitted as authentication passwords
Yes; they identify the shared area
No; process IDs are locally significant
Only when the interface is Ethernet

rationale.en: The process ID is local and is not the area ID.
rationale.fa: شناسه فرایند محلی است و شناسه ناحیه نیست.
rationale.de: Die Prozess-ID ist lokal und nicht die Bereichs-ID.

text: What does network 10.10.5.0 0.0.0.255 area 0 do under router ospf?
options: Advertises an arbitrary remote route without an interface
Assigns DHCP addresses in that subnet
Enables OSPF area 0 on interfaces whose IPv4 addresses match

rationale.en: The network statement selects matching local interfaces.
rationale.fa: فرمان network رابط‌های محلی منطبق را انتخاب می‌کند.
rationale.de: Die network-Anweisung wählt passende lokale Schnittstellen.

text: Which OSPF network statement selects only interface address 192.0.2.1?

rationale.en: A zero wildcard matches that exact address.
rationale.fa: wildcard صفر فقط همان آدرس را منطبق می‌کند.
rationale.de: Eine Null-Wildcard passt nur auf diese genaue Adresse.

text: Which interface command enables OSPF process 5 in area 0?

rationale.en: Interface-level activation specifies process and area.
rationale.fa: فعال‌سازی روی رابط، فرایند و ناحیه را مشخص می‌کند.
rationale.de: Die Interface-Aktivierung nennt Prozess und Bereich.

text: An OSPF statement is network 172.22.0.0 0.0.255.255 area 0. Which interface is selected?

rationale.en: The wildcard requires the first two octets to match.
rationale.fa: wildcard دو بخش اول را الزاماً منطبق می‌کند.
rationale.de: Die Wildcard verlangt passende erste zwei Oktette.

text: A LAN subnet should be advertised by OSPF, but there are no router neighbors on that LAN. What interface treatment fits?
options: Set the router ID to the LAN broadcast
Make the OSPF-enabled LAN interface passive

rationale.en: A passive OSPF interface suppresses Hellos while advertising its network.
rationale.fa: رابط passive پیام Hello را متوقف اما شبکه را تبلیغ می‌کند.
rationale.de: Ein passives OSPF-Interface unterdrückt Hellos, bewirbt aber sein Netz.

text: Which command checks OSPF neighbor states and IDs?

rationale.en: The neighbor view reports OSPF relationships.
rationale.fa: نمای neighbor روابط OSPF را گزارش می‌کند.
rationale.de: Die Nachbaransicht zeigt OSPF-Beziehungen.

text: Which command best checks an OSPF interface's area, cost, network type and timers?

rationale.en: The OSPF interface view includes these parameters.
rationale.fa: نمای رابط OSPF این پارامترها را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Die OSPF-Interface-Ansicht enthält diese Parameter.

text: Which command displays OSPF link-state database information?

rationale.en: The database command displays learned LSAs.
rationale.fa: فرمان database، LSAهای آموخته‌شده را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Der Datenbankbefehl zeigt gelernte LSAs.

text: Which router-configuration command explicitly sets OSPF router ID 1.1.1.1?

rationale.en: router-id sets the process identifier explicitly.
rationale.fa: router-id شناسه روتر را صریح تنظیم می‌کند.
rationale.de: router-id setzt die Routerkennung ausdrücklich.

text: When an IOS OSPF process starts without an explicit router ID, loopbacks are 10.1.1.1 and 10.9.9.9. What is normally selected?

rationale.en: IOS prefers the highest eligible loopback address.
rationale.fa: IOS بالاترین آدرس loopback واجد شرایط را ترجیح می‌دهد.
rationale.de: IOS bevorzugt die höchste geeignete Loopback-Adresse.

text: An IOS OSPF process starts with no manual ID or loopbacks. Eligible active interfaces are 192.0.2.1 and 198.51.100.1. Which router ID is normally chosen?
options: The interface with the shortest name

rationale.en: Without a loopback, IOS selects the highest eligible active-interface address.
rationale.fa: بدون loopback، IOS بالاترین آدرس رابط فعال واجد شرایط را انتخاب می‌کند.
rationale.de: Ohne Loopback wählt IOS die höchste geeignete aktive Interface-Adresse.

text: Must a manually configured OSPF router ID also be an assigned interface IP address?
options: Yes; it must be a multicast address
Yes; it must always be the WAN next hop
No; it is a unique 32-bit identifier
Only if it is greater than 110

rationale.en: The ID identifies the router; it need not be a reachable interface address.
rationale.fa: شناسه روتر لازم نیست آدرس قابل دسترسی یک رابط باشد.
rationale.de: Die Router-ID muss keine erreichbare Schnittstellenadresse sein.

text: Two OSPF routers in the same area use the same router ID. What should be corrected?

rationale.en: Router IDs must uniquely identify OSPF routers.
rationale.fa: شناسه‌ها باید روترهای OSPF را یکتا مشخص کنند.
rationale.de: Router-IDs müssen OSPF-Router eindeutig identifizieren.

text: Neighbors share area 0 and a subnet, but one uses Hello/Dead 10/40 and the other 5/20. What prevents adjacency?

rationale.en: Neighbor Hello and Dead intervals must match.
rationale.fa: فاصله‌های Hello و Dead همسایه باید یکسان باشند.
rationale.de: Hello- und Dead-Intervalle der Nachbarn müssen übereinstimmen.

text: R1 places a shared link in area 0 and R2 places it in area 1. What is the required correction for this single-area lab?
options: Give both routers the same router ID
Use the same area on the shared link

rationale.en: Neighbors on a link must agree on the OSPF area.
rationale.fa: همسایه‌های لینک باید روی ناحیه OSPF توافق داشته باشند.
rationale.de: Nachbarn am Link müssen denselben OSPF-Bereich verwenden.

text: On a normal OSPF broadcast Ethernet segment, R1 uses /24 and R2 uses /25. Which issue can block neighbor formation?

rationale.en: Broadcast OSPF neighbors require compatible subnet masks.
rationale.fa: همسایه‌های OSPF پخش‌شونده به ماسک سازگار نیاز دارند.
rationale.de: OSPF-Broadcast-Nachbarn benötigen passende Netzmasken.

text: OSPF authentication is enabled, and two peers have different authentication keys. What is expected?
options: They exchange routes through DNS instead
They form adjacency using the higher key
The keys are ignored for OSPFv2
Their OSPF packets fail authentication and adjacency fails

rationale.en: Authentication settings and keys must match.
rationale.fa: تنظیمات و کلیدهای احراز هویت باید منطبق باشند.
rationale.de: Authentifizierungseinstellungen und Schlüssel müssen übereinstimmen.

text: What is the typical default OSPF Hello interval on Cisco broadcast Ethernet interfaces?

rationale.en: The broadcast default Hello interval is ten seconds.
rationale.fa: Hello پیش‌فرض پخش‌شونده ده ثانیه است.
rationale.de: Das Standard-Hello-Intervall im Broadcast-Netz beträgt zehn Sekunden.

text: What is the typical default OSPF Dead interval on Cisco broadcast Ethernet interfaces?

rationale.en: The broadcast default Dead interval is forty seconds.
rationale.fa: Dead پیش‌فرض پخش‌شونده چهل ثانیه است.
rationale.de: Das Standard-Dead-Intervall im Broadcast-Netz beträgt vierzig Sekunden.

text: An OSPF neighbor remains in INIT. What has the local router not yet confirmed?
options: That all hosts have DHCP leases
That the neighbor has a hostname
That its own router ID appears in the neighbor's Hello
That the link uses a trunk

rationale.en: INIT indicates Hellos received without confirmed bidirectional visibility.
rationale.fa: INIT یعنی Hello رسیده اما دید دوطرفه تأیید نشده است.
rationale.de: INIT bedeutet empfangene Hellos ohne bestätigte beidseitige Sichtbarkeit.

text: Two DROTHER routers on a healthy broadcast segment remain in 2-WAY with each other. Is that necessarily a fault?
options: Yes; all priorities must be zero
Yes; all routers must be FULL with every other router
No; DROTHER pairs normally do not form full adjacency

rationale.en: DROTHERs form full adjacencies with the DR and BDR.
rationale.fa: DROTHERها با DR و BDR همجواری کامل می‌سازند.
rationale.de: DROTHER bilden vollständige Nachbarschaften mit DR und BDR.

text: What does OSPF neighbor state FULL indicate?
options: Link-state databases have synchronized for that adjacency
The interface is physically full-duplex only
The router has no remaining bandwidth

rationale.en: FULL signifies completed database synchronization.
rationale.fa: FULL یعنی همگام‌سازی پایگاه وضعیت لینک کامل شده است.
rationale.de: FULL kennzeichnet abgeschlossene Datenbanksynchronisierung.

text: Neighbors exchange Hellos but remain in EXSTART/EXCHANGE, and their interface MTUs differ. What should be checked?
options: Only the default gateway on a PC

rationale.en: An MTU mismatch can disrupt OSPF database exchange.
rationale.fa: ناسازگاری MTU می‌تواند تبادل پایگاه OSPF را مختل کند.
rationale.de: Eine MTU-Abweichung kann den OSPF-Datenbankaustausch stören.

text: During a fresh simultaneous DR election, R1 has priority 10 and ID 1.1.1.1; R2 has priority 20 and ID 0.0.0.2. Who becomes DR?
options: R1 because its ID is higher
R2 because priority is compared first

rationale.en: Higher eligible interface priority wins the election.
rationale.fa: اولویت رابط بالاتر واجد شرایط، در انتخاب برنده است.
rationale.de: Die höhere geeignete Interface-Priorität gewinnt die Wahl.

text: During a fresh election with equal eligible priorities, router IDs are 2.2.2.2 and 9.9.9.9. Which wins the DR tie?

rationale.en: The highest router ID breaks a priority tie.
rationale.fa: شناسه روتر بالاتر، تساوی اولویت را حل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Die höchste Router-ID entscheidet bei gleicher Priorität.

text: What is the effect of ip ospf priority 0 on a broadcast interface?
options: The router is ineligible for DR and BDR on that segment
The interface stops forwarding all IP

rationale.en: Priority zero excludes DR/BDR election eligibility.
rationale.fa: اولویت صفر، صلاحیت انتخاب DR/BDR را حذف می‌کند.
rationale.de: Priorität null schließt die DR/BDR-Wählbarkeit aus.

text: A stable DR already exists. A new router joins with priority 255. What happens in ordinary OSPF operation?
options: The new router immediately replaces the DR
The existing DR remains; the election is nonpreemptive
All routers reset their process IDs
The new router disables the BDR

rationale.en: Higher priority does not preempt an existing OSPF DR.
rationale.fa: اولویت بالاتر، DR موجود OSPF را پیش‌دستانه جایگزین نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Eine höhere Priorität verdrängt einen bestehenden OSPF-DR nicht.

text: The DR fails on an OSPF broadcast segment with a healthy BDR. What is the expected transition?
options: The highest source MAC must become DR

rationale.en: The BDR takes over the designated-router role.
rationale.fa: BDR نقش روتر تعیین‌شده را به عهده می‌گیرد.
rationale.de: Der BDR übernimmt die DR-Rolle.

text: Does OSPF elect a DR/BDR on a point-to-point network type?
options: Only a DR, never a BDR

rationale.en: Point-to-point OSPF does not need DR/BDR election.
rationale.fa: OSPF نقطه‌به‌نقطه به انتخاب DR/BDR نیاز ندارد.
rationale.de: Punkt-zu-Punkt-OSPF benötigt keine DR/BDR-Wahl.

text: Which interface command explicitly sets OSPF network type point-to-point?

rationale.en: The network-type command is configured on the interface.
rationale.fa: فرمان نوع شبکه روی رابط تنظیم می‌شود.
rationale.de: Der Netzwerktyp wird auf der Schnittstelle konfiguriert.

text: Which interface command sets OSPF DR election priority to 50?

rationale.en: Interface priority affects DR/BDR election.
rationale.fa: اولویت رابط بر انتخاب DR/BDR اثر دارد.
rationale.de: Die Interface-Priorität beeinflusst die DR/BDR-Wahl.

text: Two single-area OSPF paths have total costs 18 and 25. Which path is preferred?
options: The one with the higher DR priority
The one with the higher router ID

rationale.en: OSPF path preference uses total cost, not DR priority.
rationale.fa: ترجیح مسیر OSPF بر هزینه کل است، نه اولویت DR.
rationale.de: Die OSPF-Pfadwahl nutzt Gesamtkosten, nicht DR-Priorität.

text: A path to a prefix has outgoing link costs 5, 10 and 20, including the final advertised network cost. What is its OSPF cost?

rationale.en: OSPF sums the costs along the path.
rationale.fa: OSPF هزینه‌های مسیر را جمع می‌کند.
rationale.de: OSPF addiert die Kosten entlang des Pfads.

text: Using reference bandwidth 100 Mbps and interface bandwidth 10 Mbps, what is the calculated OSPF interface cost?

rationale.en: Cost is reference bandwidth divided by interface bandwidth.
rationale.fa: هزینه برابر پهنای مرجع تقسیم بر پهنای رابط است.
rationale.de: Kosten sind Referenzbandbreite geteilt durch Interface-Bandbreite.

text: With default Cisco reference bandwidth 100 Mbps, why can 1-Gbps and 10-Gbps interfaces both have OSPF cost 1?
options: Both links actually run at 100 Mbps
Calculated cost is bounded to a minimum of 1

rationale.en: The default reference cannot distinguish these faster links by cost.
rationale.fa: مرجع پیش‌فرض این لینک‌های سریع‌تر را با هزینه تفکیک نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Die Standardreferenz unterscheidet diese schnelleren Links nicht anhand der Kosten.

text: A lab raises OSPF reference bandwidth to represent high-speed links. What should be done throughout the OSPF domain?

rationale.en: Consistent reference settings avoid inconsistent path costs.
rationale.fa: مرجع یکسان از هزینه‌های ناسازگار جلوگیری می‌کند.
rationale.de: Einheitliche Referenzwerte vermeiden inkonsistente Pfadkosten.

text: An interface has ip ospf cost 40. What is used instead of the bandwidth-derived cost?

rationale.en: Manual interface cost overrides the calculated value.
rationale.fa: هزینه دستی رابط، مقدار محاسبه‌شده را جایگزین می‌کند.
rationale.de: Manuelle Interface-Kosten ersetzen den berechneten Wert.

text: What information should fully synchronized routers in the same OSPF area share?
options: An identical routing table for every destination

rationale.en: They share area topology information, but compute routes from their own position.
rationale.fa: توپولوژی ناحیه مشترک است، اما مسیر از موقعیت هر روتر محاسبه می‌شود.
rationale.de: Sie teilen die Bereichstopologie, berechnen Routen aber vom eigenen Standort.

text: How is OSPFv2 carried in IPv4, and which multicast group reaches all OSPF routers on a link?

rationale.en: OSPF uses IP protocol 89; AllSPFRouters is 224.0.0.5.
rationale.fa: OSPF پروتکل IP شماره 89 دارد؛ گروه همه روترها 224.0.0.5 است.
rationale.de: OSPF nutzt IP-Protokoll 89; AllSPFRouters ist 224.0.0.5.

text: show ip ospf neighbor lists Neighbor ID 4.4.4.4 and Address 192.0.2.4. Which is the peer's OSPF router ID?

rationale.en: Neighbor ID is the router ID; Address is the neighbor interface IP.
rationale.fa: Neighbor ID شناسه روتر و Address آدرس رابط همسایه است.
rationale.de: Neighbor ID ist die Router-ID; Address die Nachbar-Interface-IP.

text: What problem do first-hop redundancy protocols primarily solve?
options: Loss of a host's default gateway when one gateway router fails

rationale.en: FHRPs provide a resilient first-hop gateway.
rationale.fa: FHRP دروازه گام اول مقاوم به خرابی فراهم می‌کند.
rationale.de: FHRPs stellen einen ausfallsicheren ersten Gateway-Hop bereit.

text: Two routers form an HSRP group with virtual IP 10.1.1.254. Which default gateway should hosts use?
options: The physical IP of only the current active router
Both router IDs separated by commas

rationale.en: Hosts use the shared virtual gateway address.
rationale.fa: میزبان‌ها از آدرس دروازه مجازی مشترک استفاده می‌کنند.
rationale.de: Hosts verwenden die gemeinsame virtuelle Gateway-Adresse.

text: Which HSRP router normally forwards traffic for a group's virtual gateway?
options: Every router using its own physical address simultaneously
The OSPF DR regardless of HSRP state

rationale.en: The active HSRP router owns the forwarding role for the group.
rationale.fa: روتر فعال HSRP نقش ارسال گروه را دارد.
rationale.de: Der aktive HSRP-Router übernimmt die Weiterleitung der Gruppe.

text: The active HSRP router fails while the standby is healthy and correctly connected. What is expected?
options: Hosts must all manually change their gateway
The standby takes over the virtual gateway
The standby adopts every client IP

rationale.en: The standby assumes the shared gateway role.
rationale.fa: روتر آماده، نقش دروازه مشترک را می‌گیرد.
rationale.de: Der Standby übernimmt die gemeinsame Gateway-Rolle.

text: Why does FHRP use a virtual MAC address along with the virtual IP?
options: To remove Ethernet addressing from the LAN
To make every host share the router MAC
To maintain a stable Layer 2 identity for the gateway

rationale.en: The gateway retains a virtual Layer 2 identity across role changes.
rationale.fa: دروازه هنگام تغییر نقش، هویت لایه دوم مجازی را حفظ می‌کند.
rationale.de: Das Gateway behält bei Rollenwechseln eine virtuelle Layer-2-Identität.

text: During an HSRP election, two eligible routers have priorities 110 and 100. Which is preferred?

rationale.en: HSRP prefers the higher priority.
rationale.fa: HSRP اولویت بالاتر را ترجیح می‌دهد.
rationale.de: HSRP bevorzugt die höhere Priorität.

text: What is the default HSRP priority on typical Cisco IOS platforms?

rationale.en: The default HSRP priority is 100.
rationale.fa: اولویت پیش‌فرض HSRP برابر 100 است.
rationale.de: Die Standardpriorität von HSRP ist 100.

text: An HSRP standby has higher priority than the active router but preemption is disabled. Must it immediately take over?
options: Yes; the OSPF DR must become active
No; higher priority alone does not preempt the active router
No; HSRP can never fail over

rationale.en: Preemption is needed to displace a functioning active router by priority.
rationale.fa: برای کنارزدن روتر فعال سالم با اولویت، preempt لازم است.
rationale.de: Zum Verdrängen eines funktionierenden aktiven Routers ist Preemption nötig.

text: A recovered primary should regain the HSRP active role once its higher priority returns. What feature is needed?

rationale.en: Preemption allows a higher-priority router to reclaim active status.
rationale.fa: Preemption به روتر پر‌اولویت اجازه بازپس‌گیری نقش فعال می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Preemption erlaubt einem höher priorisierten Router die Rückübernahme.

text: An HSRP router has priority 120 and a tracked-uplink failure decrement of 30. What is its effective priority?

rationale.en: Subtract the configured decrement from the base priority.
rationale.fa: کاهش تنظیم‌شده از اولویت پایه کم می‌شود.
rationale.de: Der konfigurierte Abzug wird von der Basispriorität abgezogen.

text: The active router's LAN remains up but its upstream fails. What can help trigger useful gateway failover?
options: Track upstream health and adjust FHRP priority
Increase the client ARP timeout indefinitely

rationale.en: Tracking connects gateway selection to upstream health.
rationale.fa: پایش، انتخاب دروازه را به سلامت بالادست مرتبط می‌کند.
rationale.de: Tracking verbindet die Gateway-Wahl mit der Upstream-Verfügbarkeit.

text: Which first-hop redundancy protocol is an IETF standard?

rationale.en: VRRP is standardized by the IETF.
rationale.fa: VRRP توسط IETF استاندارد شده است.
rationale.de: VRRP ist durch die IETF standardisiert.

text: Which Cisco FHRP can distribute forwarding across multiple active virtual forwarders?
options: A single HSRP group with one active router

rationale.en: GLBP provides gateway load balancing through virtual forwarders.
rationale.fa: GLBP با ارسال‌کننده‌های مجازی، بار دروازه را توزیع می‌کند.
rationale.de: GLBP verteilt Gateway-Last über virtuelle Weiterleiter.

text: Hosts can reach an HSRP virtual gateway, but both routers lack a route to the remote network. What is true?
options: FHRP does not replace correct upstream routing
The virtual IP creates all remote routes automatically
Increasing HSRP priority fixes every missing route
The standby must assign new client IPs

rationale.en: Gateway redundancy and remote route availability are separate.
rationale.fa: افزونگی دروازه و وجود مسیر دور، دو موضوع جدا هستند.
rationale.de: Gateway-Redundanz und verfügbare Fernrouten sind getrennte Aufgaben.

text: Which command summarizes HSRP state, group, priority and virtual IP?

rationale.en: show standby brief reports HSRP group status.
rationale.fa: show standby brief وضعیت گروه HSRP را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: show standby brief zeigt den HSRP-Gruppenstatus.

text: Which term describes a weakness that an attacker could use?

rationale.en: A vulnerability is an exploitable weakness.
rationale.fa: آسیب‌پذیری، ضعفی قابل سوءاستفاده است.
rationale.de: Eine Schwachstelle ist eine ausnutzbare Schwäche.

text: An attacker uses a known software flaw to run unauthorized code. What is the action called?

rationale.en: An exploit takes advantage of a vulnerability.
rationale.fa: بهره‌برداری از یک آسیب‌پذیری استفاده می‌کند.
rationale.de: Ein Exploit nutzt eine Schwachstelle aus.

text: Installing a vendor patch for a known router vulnerability is an example of what?

rationale.en: Patching reduces exposure to a vulnerability.
rationale.fa: وصله، خطر ناشی از آسیب‌پذیری را کاهش می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Ein Patch reduziert das Risiko einer Schwachstelle.

text: A flood of traffic prevents legitimate users from reaching a service. Which security property is primarily affected?

rationale.en: Denial of service primarily harms availability.
rationale.fa: حمله منع سرویس، دسترس‌پذیری را مختل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Dienstverweigerung beeinträchtigt hauptsächlich die Verfügbarkeit.

text: An unauthorized person reads private payroll traffic. Which property is compromised?

rationale.en: Confidentiality protects data from unauthorized disclosure.
rationale.fa: محرمانگی، داده را از افشای غیرمجاز حفظ می‌کند.
rationale.de: Vertraulichkeit schützt vor unbefugter Offenlegung.

text: An attacker silently changes a financial transaction in transit. Which property is primarily compromised?

rationale.en: Integrity protects against unauthorized alteration.
rationale.fa: یکپارچگی، داده را از تغییر غیرمجاز حفظ می‌کند.
rationale.de: Integrität schützt vor unbefugter Veränderung.

text: A fake help-desk message asks an employee to enter credentials on an imitation site. What attack is this?

rationale.en: Phishing deceives users into exposing sensitive information.
rationale.fa: فیشینگ با فریب، اطلاعات حساس را دریافت می‌کند.
rationale.de: Phishing täuscht Nutzer zur Preisgabe sensibler Informationen.

text: What does defense in depth mean?
options: Relying on one strong password for everything
Removing internal controls after installing a firewall

rationale.en: Layered controls reduce dependence on one safeguard.
rationale.fa: کنترل‌های چندلایه، وابستگی به یک محافظ را کم می‌کنند.
rationale.de: Mehrere Schutzschichten reduzieren die Abhängigkeit von einer Maßnahme.

text: A visitor follows an employee through a secured door without presenting a badge. What issue occurred?

rationale.en: Tailgating bypasses physical access checks.
rationale.fa: دنباله‌روی، کنترل دسترسی فیزیکی را دور می‌زند.
rationale.de: Tailgating umgeht physische Zugangskontrollen.

text: Which measure most directly limits unauthorized physical access to network devices?
options: Locked communications rooms with controlled entry

rationale.en: Controlled entry protects the physical equipment.
rationale.fa: ورود کنترل‌شده، تجهیزات فیزیکی را محافظت می‌کند.
rationale.de: Kontrollierter Zutritt schützt die Geräte.

text: A company wants staff to recognize fraudulent password-reset messages. Which program element fits?

rationale.en: Awareness training helps users recognize deception.
rationale.fa: آموزش آگاهی، تشخیص فریب را تقویت می‌کند.
rationale.de: Sensibilisierung hilft Nutzern, Täuschungen zu erkennen.

text: An employee finds an unknown USB drive outside the office. What is the appropriate action?
options: Disable endpoint protection to inspect it
Plug it into a production router console computer
Copy every file to a shared drive
Report it under the organization's security procedure

rationale.en: Unknown removable media can carry malicious content.
rationale.fa: رسانه ناشناس ممکن است محتوای مخرب داشته باشد.
rationale.de: Unbekannte Wechselmedien können Schadsoftware enthalten.

text: Why should network equipment disposal follow a documented process?
options: Stored configuration may contain sensitive information
Used equipment has no residual data

rationale.en: Configuration and credentials must be removed appropriately.
rationale.fa: تنظیمات و اطلاعات ورود باید به‌درستی پاک شوند.
rationale.de: Konfiguration und Zugangsdaten müssen angemessen entfernt werden.

text: Which IOS command defines a local user with a hashed secret?

rationale.en: username ... secret creates a local account with a secret.
rationale.fa: فرمان username ... secret حساب محلی با رمز می‌سازد.
rationale.de: username ... secret erstellt ein lokales Konto mit Secret.

text: VTY lines should authenticate using the local username database. Which line command is required?

rationale.en: login local selects the local account database.
rationale.fa: login local پایگاه حساب‌های محلی را انتخاب می‌کند.
rationale.de: login local verwendet die lokale Benutzerverwaltung.

text: Which command protects entry into privileged EXEC mode with a secret?

rationale.en: enable secret protects privileged EXEC access.
rationale.fa: enable secret دسترسی EXEC ممتاز را محافظت می‌کند.
rationale.de: enable secret schützt den privilegierten EXEC-Zugriff.

text: A VTY line has login local, but the router has no local user accounts. What is needed for local login?
options: Create an appropriate username and secret

rationale.en: Local authentication needs an account in the local database.
rationale.fa: احراز هویت محلی به حساب در پایگاه محلی نیاز دارد.
rationale.de: Lokale Authentifizierung benötigt ein lokales Benutzerkonto.

text: Which VTY command restricts remote sessions to SSH?

rationale.en: transport input ssh permits SSH on those lines.
rationale.fa: transport input ssh روی این خطوط SSH را مجاز می‌کند.
rationale.de: transport input ssh erlaubt SSH auf diesen Leitungen.

text: Why is service password-encryption alone insufficient protection for IOS type 7 passwords?
options: Type 7 is reversible obfuscation, not strong password hashing

rationale.en: Type 7 can be reversed; use stronger secret mechanisms.
rationale.fa: نوع 7 قابل بازگردانی است؛ رمزهای قوی‌تر لازم‌اند.
rationale.de: Typ 7 ist reversibel; stärkere Secret-Verfahren sind nötig.

text: A remote administrator needs secure management over an untrusted network. Which choice is preferable?
options: Plain HTTP with a hidden URL

rationale.en: SSH encrypts the management session.
rationale.fa: SSH نشست مدیریتی را رمزنگاری می‌کند.
rationale.de: SSH verschlüsselt die Verwaltungssitzung.

text: What is the purpose of exec-timeout 5 0 under VTY lines?
options: Disconnect an idle EXEC session after five minutes
Rotate the password every five minutes
Wait five minutes before routing packets
Limit SSH packets to five bytes

rationale.en: exec-timeout limits idle session duration.
rationale.fa: exec-timeout مدت بی‌کاری نشست را محدود می‌کند.
rationale.de: exec-timeout begrenzt die Leerlaufzeit einer Sitzung.

text: Which example uses two different authentication factors?
options: A password and a hardware security key
A password and its reminder question
A username and an email address

rationale.en: A password is knowledge; a security key is possession.
rationale.fa: رمز عامل دانستن و کلید امنیتی عامل داشتن است.
rationale.de: Passwort ist Wissen; Sicherheitsschlüssel ist Besitz.

text: A shared administrator account makes it hard to identify who changed a router. What improves accountability?
options: One shared password for every engineer

rationale.en: Individual identities support attribution of actions.
rationale.fa: هویت‌های جدا، انتساب فعالیت‌ها را ممکن می‌کنند.
rationale.de: Individuelle Identitäten ermöglichen die Zuordnung von Aktionen.

text: Which authentication factor category includes a fingerprint?

rationale.en: Biometrics represent inherence: something you are.
rationale.fa: بیومتریک، ویژگی ذاتی فرد است.
rationale.de: Biometrie gehört zu einem persönlichen Merkmal.

text: A user reuses the router password on an unrelated site that is breached. What reduces this risk?
options: Unique passwords stored in an approved password manager
The same password with a shared suffix

rationale.en: Unique credentials limit cross-service compromise.
rationale.fa: رمزهای یکتا، سرایت نفوذ بین سرویس‌ها را محدود می‌کنند.
rationale.de: Einzigartige Zugangsdaten begrenzen dienstübergreifende Kompromittierung.

text: What must be protected when certificate-based authentication uses a public/private key pair?
options: The public certificate subject name only
The public key as a password

rationale.en: The private key proves control of the identity.
rationale.fa: کلید خصوصی، کنترل هویت را اثبات می‌کند.
rationale.de: Der private Schlüssel belegt die Kontrolle über die Identität.

text: An administrator leaves the company. Which credential-management action is necessary?
options: Leave the account active for convenience
Revoke their access and rotate shared secrets they knew
Disable password logging but retain access

rationale.en: Access must end; exposed shared credentials need rotation.
rationale.fa: دسترسی باید قطع و رمزهای مشترک شناخته‌شده عوض شوند.
rationale.de: Zugriff muss enden; bekannte gemeinsame Secrets sind zu wechseln.

text: Which password policy choice best resists guessing?
options: A short password changed only in capitalization
The company name for all users
Long, unique passwords with appropriate MFA

rationale.en: Length, uniqueness and MFA improve resistance to compromise.
rationale.fa: طول، یکتایی و MFA مقاومت در برابر نفوذ را افزایش می‌دهند.
rationale.de: Länge, Einzigartigkeit und MFA erhöhen den Schutz.

text: Two offices need protected communication between their networks over the Internet. Which VPN type fits?
options: Remote-access VPN for one employee only
An unencrypted VLAN trunk across the Internet

rationale.en: Site-to-site VPNs connect networks through VPN gateways.
rationale.fa: VPN سایت‌به‌سایت، شبکه‌ها را از طریق دروازه‌ها متصل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Site-to-Site-VPNs verbinden Netze über VPN-Gateways.

text: A travelling employee must securely connect a laptop to the corporate network. Which approach fits?

rationale.en: Remote-access VPNs connect individual remote users.
rationale.fa: VPN دسترسی راه دور، کاربر دور را وصل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Remote-Access-VPNs verbinden einzelne entfernte Nutzer.

text: What is encapsulated by IPsec tunnel mode?
options: The original IP packet inside a new outer IP packet

rationale.en: Tunnel mode carries the original IP packet within an outer packet.
rationale.fa: حالت تونل، بسته IP اصلی را در بسته بیرونی حمل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Tunnelmodus transportiert das ursprüngliche IP-Paket in einem äußeren Paket.

text: Which IPsec protocol can provide payload confidentiality through encryption?

rationale.en: ESP can encrypt protected traffic.
rationale.fa: ESP می‌تواند ترافیک محافظت‌شده را رمزنگاری کند.
rationale.de: ESP kann geschützten Verkehr verschlüsseln.

text: Why is peer authentication important when establishing an IPsec VPN?
options: To verify the remote endpoint's identity
To remove the need for routing

rationale.en: Authentication prevents trusting an unverified VPN peer.
rationale.fa: احراز هویت از اعتماد به همتای تأییدنشده جلوگیری می‌کند.
rationale.de: Authentifizierung verhindert Vertrauen in ungeprüfte VPN-Gegenstellen.

text: A site-to-site VPN is established, but the remote subnet has no route on the local gateway. What must also be correct?
options: Routing and policy for the protected traffic
The browser cache on the administrator PC

rationale.en: An established tunnel does not replace correct traffic routing.
rationale.fa: تونل برقرار، جایگزین مسیریابی صحیح ترافیک نیست.
rationale.de: Ein aktiver Tunnel ersetzt keine korrekte Verkehrsroute.

text: With split tunneling, which traffic typically uses the VPN?
options: Traffic selected by the VPN policy

rationale.en: Split tunneling sends selected traffic through the tunnel.
rationale.fa: تونل تفکیکی، ترافیک انتخاب‌شده را از VPN می‌فرستد.
rationale.de: Split-Tunneling leitet ausgewählten Verkehr durch das VPN.

text: A standard IPv4 ACL primarily filters on which field?

rationale.en: Standard ACLs match source IPv4 addresses.
rationale.fa: ACL استاندارد، آدرس IPv4 مبدأ را تطبیق می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Standard-ACLs prüfen IPv4-Quelladressen.

text: What can an extended IPv4 ACL match that a standard ACL cannot?

rationale.en: Extended ACLs add protocol, destination and port criteria.
rationale.fa: ACL گسترده، پروتکل، مقصد و پورت را نیز می‌سنجد.
rationale.de: Erweiterte ACLs prüfen zusätzlich Protokoll, Ziel und Ports.

text: ACL lines are: 10 permit ip any any; 20 deny tcp any host 192.0.2.8 eq 22. What happens to matching SSH traffic?
options: The router chooses the more specific line automatically

rationale.en: The first matching ACL entry determines the action.
rationale.fa: اولین قانون منطبق، نتیجه ACL را تعیین می‌کند.
rationale.de: Der erste passende ACL-Eintrag bestimmt die Aktion.

text: An applied IPv4 ACL contains only permit tcp any host 192.0.2.8 eq 443. What happens to UDP DNS traffic?
options: It is translated by NAT automatically
It is permitted because DNS is common
It is denied by the implicit deny

rationale.en: Unmatched traffic hits the implicit deny.
rationale.fa: ترافیک نامنطبق به رد ضمنی می‌رسد.
rationale.de: Nicht passender Verkehr trifft auf die implizite Ablehnung.

text: Which wildcard matches only host 10.2.3.4?

rationale.en: Zero wildcard bits require all corresponding address bits to match.
rationale.fa: بیت صفر wildcard، تطابق بیت آدرس را الزامی می‌کند.
rationale.de: Wildcard-Bits mit Wert null verlangen passende Adressbits.

text: Which wildcard matches the entire 172.16.8.0/24 subnet?

rationale.en: The final eight bits are ignored.
rationale.fa: هشت بیت آخر نادیده گرفته می‌شوند.
rationale.de: Die letzten acht Bits werden ignoriert.

text: Which wildcard corresponds to the contiguous subnet 10.20.32.0/20?

rationale.en: Invert the /20 mask 255.255.240.0.
rationale.fa: ماسک /20 یعنی 255.255.240.0 را معکوس می‌کنیم.
rationale.de: Die /20-Maske 255.255.240.0 wird invertiert.

text: Which ACE allows HTTPS from any source to 192.0.2.10?

rationale.en: HTTPS normally uses TCP destination port 443.
rationale.fa: HTTPS معمولاً پورت مقصد TCP 443 دارد.
rationale.de: HTTPS verwendet normalerweise TCP-Zielport 443.

text: A rule must permit DNS over UDP from 10.10.1.0/24 to 192.0.2.53. Which ACE fits?

rationale.en: The source subnet and destination UDP port must match.
rationale.fa: زیرشبکه مبدأ و پورت UDP مقصد باید منطبق باشند.
rationale.de: Quellsubnetz und UDP-Zielport müssen passen.

text: An ACL is applied inbound on the LAN-facing interface. Which packets does it evaluate there?
options: Packets entering the router from that LAN
Packets leaving the router toward that LAN only
Only packets created on the router

rationale.en: Inbound is relative to the router interface.
rationale.fa: جهت ورودی نسبت به رابط روتر تعریف می‌شود.
rationale.de: Eingehend bezieht sich auf die Router-Schnittstelle.

text: A filter is applied outbound on the WAN interface. At what point does it inspect forwarded packets?
options: Only when they enter the LAN host
Before they leave that WAN interface
Only after they reach the remote server

rationale.en: Outbound ACLs filter packets leaving their interface.
rationale.fa: ACL خروجی، بسته‌های در حال خروج از رابط را می‌سنجد.
rationale.de: Ausgehende ACLs filtern Pakete beim Verlassen der Schnittstelle.

text: Which interface command applies named IPv4 ACL WEB inbound?

rationale.en: ip access-group applies an IPv4 interface ACL.
rationale.fa: ip access-group، ACL را روی رابط اعمال می‌کند.
rationale.de: ip access-group wendet eine IPv4-ACL auf eine Schnittstelle an.

text: An engineer creates an ACL, but packets remain unaffected and no interface references it. What is missing?
options: Application of the ACL to the appropriate interface or feature

rationale.en: Defining an ACL alone does not attach it to packet filtering.
rationale.fa: ساخت ACL به‌تنهایی آن را به فیلتر ترافیک متصل نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Eine ACL-Definition allein aktiviert keinen Interface-Filter.

text: ACL 10 denies host 10.1.1.9, then permits any. Which source is blocked?

rationale.en: The host-specific deny matches before permit any.
rationale.fa: رد میزبان مشخص پیش از permit any تطبیق می‌یابد.
rationale.de: Die hostbezogene Ablehnung greift vor permit any.

text: ACL: deny tcp 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 23; permit ip any any. A 10.0.0.25 packet goes to TCP port 22. What happens?
options: Dropped because all TCP is denied

rationale.en: Port 22 does not match the port-23 deny.
rationale.fa: پورت 22 با قانون رد پورت 23 منطبق نیست.
rationale.de: Port 22 passt nicht zur Ablehnung für Port 23.

text: ACL: permit tcp host 10.1.1.5 host 192.0.2.20 eq 443; deny ip any any. A return TCP packet from 192.0.2.20:443 to 10.1.1.5:51000 meets this same ACL. What happens?
options: Permitted because the flow previously sent HTTPS
Denied because its source and destination do not match the permit

rationale.en: A basic ACL does not automatically track this connection.
rationale.fa: ACL ساده این اتصال را خودکار به‌صورت حالتمند دنبال نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Eine einfache ACL verfolgt diese Verbindung nicht automatisch zustandsbehaftet.

text: Where is an extended ACL generally placed to stop unwanted traffic early?
options: Always on the destination host only
Close to the source, subject to design requirements

rationale.en: Extended ACL criteria can limit traffic near its source.
rationale.fa: ACL گسترده می‌تواند ترافیک را نزدیک مبدأ محدود کند.
rationale.de: Erweiterte ACLs können Verkehr nahe der Quelle begrenzen.

text: Why are standard ACLs commonly placed closer to the destination?
options: Their source-only matching could otherwise block unrelated destinations
They require the destination MAC address

rationale.en: Source-only filters cannot distinguish destination networks.
rationale.fa: فیلتر مبدأمحور، شبکه‌های مقصد را تفکیک نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Reine Quellfilter unterscheiden keine Zielnetze.

text: Which command displays IPv4 ACL entries and match counters?

rationale.en: show ip access-lists reports ACL rules and counters.
rationale.fa: show ip access-lists قوانین و شمارنده‌های ACL را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: show ip access-lists zeigt ACL-Regeln und Trefferzähler.

text: A deny ACE has a zero match count despite known test traffic. What should be verified first?
options: ACL attachment, direction and packet fields
Only the system clock display format

rationale.en: Traffic must traverse the applied ACL with matching fields.
rationale.fa: ترافیک باید از ACL اعمال‌شده با مشخصات منطبق عبور کند.
rationale.de: Verkehr muss die angewendete ACL mit passenden Feldern durchlaufen.

options: Yes, it is in the 16–31 range

rationale.en: Four ignored host bits cover addresses .16 through .31.
rationale.fa: چهار بیت نادیده، بازه .16 تا .31 را پوشش می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Vier ignorierte Hostbits umfassen .16 bis .31.

text: An IPv4 ACL permits ICMP but has no other permit entries. What happens to an SSH connection through that ACL?
options: It is denied because SSH uses TCP
It is permitted because ICMP permits all IP

rationale.en: An ICMP permit does not permit TCP traffic.
rationale.fa: مجوز ICMP، ترافیک TCP را مجاز نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Eine ICMP-Freigabe erlaubt keinen TCP-Verkehr.

text: A named ACL entry must document why a rule exists without filtering packets. Which command is suitable?

rationale.en: remark adds explanatory text to an ACL.
rationale.fa: remark متن توضیحی به ACL اضافه می‌کند.
rationale.de: remark ergänzt eine Erläuterung in der ACL.

text: ACL: 10 deny ip host 10.0.0.8 any; 20 permit tcp 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 443. What happens to HTTPS from 10.0.0.8?

rationale.en: The earlier host deny wins even for HTTPS.
rationale.fa: رد زودتر میزبان، حتی برای HTTPS اعمال می‌شود.
rationale.de: Die frühere Hostablehnung gilt auch für HTTPS.

text: A VTY access-class permits only the management subnet. What is its intended scope?
options: Restricting access to the device's remote terminal lines

rationale.en: VTY access-class controls terminal access, not general forwarding.
rationale.fa: access-class روی VTY دسترسی ترمینال را کنترل می‌کند.
rationale.de: VTY access-class steuert Terminalzugriff, nicht allgemeine Weiterleitung.

text: Which feature blocks rogue DHCP server messages arriving on untrusted access ports?

rationale.en: DHCP snooping filters server messages on untrusted ports.
rationale.fa: DHCP snooping پیام سرور روی پورت نامطمئن را فیلتر می‌کند.
rationale.de: DHCP-Snooping filtert Servernachrichten auf nicht vertrauenswürdigen Ports.

text: A switch uplink leads to the legitimate DHCP server. Client offers are being dropped after enabling snooping. What should be checked?
options: Whether every client port is trusted
Whether the server-facing ingress path is trusted

rationale.en: Legitimate server messages need an appropriate trusted path.
rationale.fa: پیام سرور مجاز به مسیر ورودی مورد اعتماد نیاز دارد.
rationale.de: Legitime Servernachrichten benötigen einen passenden vertrauenswürdigen Eingang.

text: Which command displays learned DHCP snooping IP-to-MAC bindings?

rationale.en: The binding command shows snooping database entries.
rationale.fa: این فرمان، رکوردهای پایگاه snooping را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Der Binding-Befehl zeigt Einträge der Snooping-Datenbank.

text: Which information normally belongs to a DHCP snooping binding?
options: Client IP, MAC, VLAN, interface and lease information

rationale.en: Bindings associate a leased address with a client and port.
rationale.fa: رکورد، آدرس اجاره‌شده را به کلاینت و پورت مرتبط می‌کند.
rationale.de: Bindungen ordnen eine geleaste Adresse einem Client und Port zu.

text: Which feature validates ARP messages against trusted bindings to resist ARP spoofing?

rationale.en: DAI checks ARP information against trusted binding data.
rationale.fa: DAI اطلاعات ARP را با داده معتبر تطبیق می‌دهد.
rationale.de: DAI prüft ARP-Daten anhand vertrauenswürdiger Bindungen.

text: A statically addressed printer loses connectivity after DAI is enabled on its untrusted port. No binding exists. What is an appropriate fix?
options: Configure a supported static ARP validation exception or binding

rationale.en: Static hosts need an approved validation path rather than a dynamic lease assumption.
rationale.fa: میزبان ثابت به روش تأیید مجاز بدون فرض اجاره DHCP نیاز دارد.
rationale.de: Statische Hosts benötigen eine zugelassene Prüfung ohne DHCP-Lease-Annahme.

text: What does switch port security primarily limit?
options: Allowed source MAC addresses on the port

rationale.en: Port security constrains source MAC usage.
rationale.fa: امنیت پورت، استفاده از MAC مبدأ را محدود می‌کند.
rationale.de: Port-Security begrenzt die Nutzung von Quell-MAC-Adressen.

text: Port security allows one learned MAC in shutdown mode. A second device sends frames. What is expected?
options: The port becomes an OSPF DR
The port becomes error-disabled for a violation

rationale.en: Shutdown violation mode error-disables the affected port.
rationale.fa: حالت shutdown، پورت متخلف را error-disabled می‌کند.
rationale.de: Der Verstoßmodus shutdown setzt den Port auf error-disabled.

text: How does restrict mode differ from protect mode in port security?
options: Restrict also records violations and sends notifications
Protect shuts down the port by default
Protect permits all unknown MAC addresses

rationale.en: Both drop violating traffic; restrict adds reporting.
rationale.fa: هر دو ترافیک متخلف را رد می‌کنند؛ restrict گزارش می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Beide verwerfen Verstöße; restrict ergänzt Meldungen.

text: Which interface command permits up to two secure MAC addresses?

rationale.en: maximum configures the secure MAC limit.
rationale.fa: maximum سقف MACهای امن را تعیین می‌کند.
rationale.de: maximum konfiguriert die Grenze sicherer MAC-Adressen.

text: A PC is connected through an IP phone on a secured access port. What must the secure MAC limit consider?
options: Both the phone and the PC source MAC addresses

rationale.en: The port can see frames sourced by both endpoints.
rationale.fa: پورت ممکن است فریم مبدأ هر دو دستگاه را ببیند.
rationale.de: Der Port kann Quell-MAC-Adressen beider Endpunkte sehen.

text: Which command displays detailed port-security status for Gi1/0/8?

rationale.en: The interface view reports limits, mode and violations.
rationale.fa: نمای رابط، سقف، حالت و تخلفات را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Die Interface-Ansicht zeigt Grenzen, Modus und Verstöße.

text: Sticky learning adds secure MAC addresses to the running configuration. What is needed to retain them after a normal reload?
options: Save the running configuration to startup configuration

rationale.en: Persisting configuration retains sticky entries across reloads.
rationale.fa: ذخیره تنظیمات، MACهای sticky را پس از راه‌اندازی حفظ می‌کند.
rationale.de: Gespeicherte Konfiguration erhält Sticky-Einträge nach Neustarts.

text: A port-security violation has been fixed, but the port remains error-disabled. Which manual action can restore it?
options: Interface shutdown followed by no shutdown

rationale.en: After fixing the cause, an interface reset can restore the port.
rationale.fa: پس از رفع علت، بازنشانی رابط می‌تواند پورت را فعال کند.
rationale.de: Nach Ursachenbehebung kann ein Interface-Neustart den Port aktivieren.

text: Why should access ports remain untrusted for DHCP snooping?
options: To prevent clients from requesting leases at all
To prevent attached clients from acting as unauthorized DHCP servers

rationale.en: Untrusted access ports reject unauthorized server messages.
rationale.fa: پورت نامطمئن، پیام سرور غیرمجاز را رد می‌کند.
rationale.de: Nicht vertrauenswürdige Zugangsports verwerfen unzulässige Servernachrichten.

text: Which two scopes must be enabled for typical IOS DHCP snooping operation on VLAN 20?
options: Global snooping and snooping for VLAN 20

rationale.en: Snooping must be enabled globally and for the relevant VLAN.
rationale.fa: Snooping باید سراسری و برای VLAN مربوطه فعال شود.
rationale.de: Snooping muss global und für das betreffende VLAN aktiviert sein.

text: Which AAA function verifies who a user is?

rationale.en: Authentication verifies identity.
rationale.fa: احراز هویت، هویت کاربر را بررسی می‌کند.
rationale.de: Authentifizierung prüft die Identität.

text: A user logs in successfully but cannot execute configuration commands. Which AAA function controls that permission?

rationale.en: Authorization determines allowed actions.
rationale.fa: مجوزدهی، عملیات مجاز را تعیین می‌کند.
rationale.de: Autorisierung bestimmt erlaubte Aktionen.

text: A server records login times and commands executed by administrators. Which AAA function is this?

rationale.en: Accounting records activity for auditing.
rationale.fa: ثبت حساب، فعالیت را برای ممیزی ذخیره می‌کند.
rationale.de: Accounting protokolliert Aktivitäten zur Prüfung.

text: A valid user is denied a privilege outside their assigned role. What principle is being enforced?

rationale.en: Least privilege grants only necessary permissions.
rationale.fa: حداقل دسترسی، فقط مجوزهای ضروری را می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Minimalberechtigung gewährt nur notwendige Rechte.

text: Which protocol is commonly used for centralized network device administration and granular command authorization?

rationale.en: TACACS+ supports centralized administrative AAA.
rationale.fa: TACACS+ از AAA مدیریتی مرکزی پشتیبانی می‌کند.
rationale.de: TACACS+ unterstützt zentrale administrative AAA.

text: A WLAN uses a central AAA server for per-user enterprise authentication. Which protocol commonly carries that exchange?

rationale.en: RADIUS commonly provides network access AAA.
rationale.fa: RADIUS معمولاً AAA دسترسی شبکه را ارائه می‌دهد.
rationale.de: RADIUS dient häufig der AAA für Netzwerkzugang.

text: Which cipher is commonly associated with WPA2 using AES?

rationale.en: WPA2 AES commonly uses CCMP.
rationale.fa: WPA2 با AES معمولاً از CCMP استفاده می‌کند.
rationale.de: WPA2 mit AES verwendet üblicherweise CCMP.

text: Which mechanism replaces the traditional PSK authentication exchange in WPA3-Personal?

rationale.en: WPA3-Personal uses Simultaneous Authentication of Equals.
rationale.fa: WPA3-Personal از SAE استفاده می‌کند.
rationale.de: WPA3-Personal verwendet Simultaneous Authentication of Equals.

text: Which WLAN security choice supports individual user credentials with a central authentication server?

rationale.en: Enterprise authentication supports per-user identities.
rationale.fa: احراز هویت سازمانی، هویت‌های جداگانه را پشتیبانی می‌کند.
rationale.de: Enterprise-Authentifizierung unterstützt individuelle Benutzeridentitäten.

text: Why is legacy WPA/TKIP generally a poor choice for a modern WLAN?
options: It is the required cipher for WPA3-Personal
It provides weaker legacy protection than modern AES-based modes
It offers stronger protection than all WPA2 modes
It eliminates the need for authentication

rationale.en: Modern WLANs should avoid legacy TKIP protection.
rationale.fa: شبکه مدرن باید از محافظت قدیمی TKIP پرهیز کند.
rationale.de: Moderne WLANs sollten veralteten TKIP-Schutz vermeiden.

text: A WLAN hides its SSID but uses no encryption. What is true?
options: Every client is authenticated with a certificate
Hiding the name does not provide traffic confidentiality

rationale.en: SSID hiding is not encryption or strong authentication.
rationale.fa: پنهان‌کردن SSID رمزنگاری یا احراز هویت قوی نیست.
rationale.de: SSID-Verbergen ersetzt weder Verschlüsselung noch starke Authentifizierung.

text: In a WLAN GUI, WPA2-Personal is selected. What additional shared credential must be configured?
options: A DHCP lease time as the password
An SNMP read-only community for clients
A pre-shared key used by clients

rationale.en: WPA2-Personal uses a shared PSK.
rationale.fa: WPA2-Personal از کلید مشترک PSK استفاده می‌کند.
rationale.de: WPA2-Personal verwendet einen gemeinsamen PSK.

text: A client sees the WLAN but cannot authenticate after the administrator changes its PSK. What should be updated?
options: The client's saved WLAN pre-shared key

rationale.en: Client and WLAN must use the matching PSK.
rationale.fa: کلاینت و WLAN باید PSK یکسان داشته باشند.
rationale.de: Client und WLAN benötigen denselben PSK.

text: A WPA2-PSK WLAN authenticates successfully, but clients receive no IP address. What should be checked next?
options: Whether accounting logs have colored text

rationale.en: Successful authentication does not prove VLAN and DHCP service.
rationale.fa: احراز هویت موفق، عملکرد VLAN و DHCP را ثابت نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Erfolgreiche Anmeldung beweist keine funktionierende VLAN- und DHCP-Anbindung.

text: A team must apply the same approved NTP servers to 80 switches. What is a direct benefit of automation?

rationale.en: Automation repeats approved changes consistently.
rationale.fa: اتوماسیون تغییرات تأییدشده را یکسان تکرار می‌کند.
rationale.de: Automatisierung setzt freigegebene Änderungen einheitlich um.

text: A script pushed an incorrect VLAN to every access switch. Which practice best reduces the impact of the next rollout?
options: Test on a small pilot group first
Apply changes faster to all switches

rationale.en: A pilot limits exposure before wider deployment.
rationale.fa: اجرای آزمایشی محدود، دامنه آسیب را کاهش می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Ein Pilot begrenzt Auswirkungen vor dem Gesamtausrollen.

text: An automation job reports success, but clients cannot reach their gateway. What should the workflow include?
options: Only checking that the script started

rationale.en: Command delivery does not prove service health.
rationale.fa: ارسال فرمان، سلامت سرویس را ثابت نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Befehlserfolg beweist keine funktionierende Verbindung.

text: What does configuration drift describe?
options: A JSON object becoming an array
Actual configuration diverging from the approved desired state

rationale.en: Drift is deviation from the desired configuration.
rationale.fa: انحراف یعنی تفاوت تنظیمات واقعی با وضعیت مطلوب.
rationale.de: Drift bedeutet Abweichung vom gewünschten Zustand.

text: An engineer reviews proposed automated changes before execution. What benefit does this provide?
options: A chance to detect unintended changes
A guarantee that outages are impossible

rationale.en: Review can reveal unintended changes before execution.
rationale.fa: بازبینی، تغییرات ناخواسته را پیش از اجرا آشکار می‌کند.
rationale.de: Prüfung kann unerwünschte Änderungen vorab erkennen.

text: A scheduled workflow collects interface counters every five minutes. What operational capability does this improve?
options: Prevention of every packet loss event

rationale.en: Regular collection supports comparable measurements over time.
rationale.fa: جمع‌آوری منظم، مقایسه روندها را ممکن می‌کند.
rationale.de: Regelmäßige Erfassung ermöglicht vergleichbare Zeitreihen.

text: Why should an automation workflow keep a record of which devices were changed?

rationale.en: Change records provide traceability.
rationale.fa: ثبت تغییرات، امکان پیگیری را فراهم می‌کند.
rationale.de: Änderungsprotokolle ermöglichen Nachvollziehbarkeit.

text: An API request times out after a configuration write. What should the script do before retrying a non-idempotent operation?
options: Check whether the original change already occurred

rationale.en: A timeout does not prove that the server rejected the operation.
rationale.fa: مهلت تمام‌شده به معنی اجرا نشدن عملیات نیست.
rationale.de: Ein Timeout beweist nicht, dass die Änderung ausblieb.

text: How does controller-based management differ from individually configuring every switch?
options: It provides a central interface for policy and automation
It eliminates every device forwarding table
It requires Ethernet frames to traverse the controller
It prevents all local device management

rationale.en: Controllers coordinate management across devices.
rationale.fa: کنترلر، مدیریت چند دستگاه را هماهنگ می‌کند.
rationale.de: Controller koordinieren die Verwaltung mehrerer Geräte.

text: A controller deploys one access policy to many edge switches. Where do ordinary packets typically get forwarded?
options: On the network devices in the data plane

rationale.en: Devices execute forwarding in their data plane.
rationale.fa: دستگاه‌ها بسته‌ها را در صفحه داده ارسال می‌کنند.
rationale.de: Die Geräte leiten Pakete in der Datenebene weiter.

text: Which traditional network function is associated with the control plane?
options: Transmitting a frame using a programmed table

rationale.en: Route computation belongs to the control plane.
rationale.fa: محاسبه مسیر، وظیفه صفحه کنترل است.
rationale.de: Routenberechnung gehört zur Kontrollebene.

text: A controller is unreachable, but switches retain valid forwarding entries. Which statement is most reasonable?
options: Every switch must immediately stop all traffic
ARP becomes an Internet routing protocol
Existing forwarding may continue; control changes may be affected

rationale.en: Impact depends on architecture; cached forwarding can continue.
rationale.fa: اثر خرابی به معماری بستگی دارد؛ ارسال موجود ممکن است ادامه یابد.
rationale.de: Die Architektur entscheidet; bestehende Weiterleitung kann weiterlaufen.

text: What is an advantage of describing network policy as intent?
options: Expressing the desired outcome without individually specifying every device command
Removing the need to define requirements
Guaranteeing that every input is correct

rationale.en: Intent states the desired result for the system.
rationale.fa: قصد شبکه، نتیجه مطلوب را بیان می‌کند.
rationale.de: Intent beschreibt das gewünschte Ergebnis.

text: A controller shows inventory for the entire campus. What task is easier than using isolated CLI sessions?
options: Checking software versions across many devices
Changing the laws of radio propagation

rationale.en: Central inventory enables fleet-wide comparison.
rationale.fa: فهرست مرکزی، مقایسه دستگاه‌ها را آسان می‌کند.
rationale.de: Zentrales Inventar erleichtert geräteübergreifende Vergleiche.

text: In a software-defined architecture, what is the underlay?
options: The physical or routed transport that carries overlay traffic

rationale.en: The underlay supplies transport connectivity.
rationale.fa: زیرلایه، ارتباط انتقالی را فراهم می‌کند.
rationale.de: Das Underlay stellt Transportverbindungen bereit.

text: What is the overlay in a tunnel-based network fabric?
options: A list of physical rack locations
Logical connectivity built over the transport network

rationale.en: An overlay adds logical connectivity over the underlay.
rationale.fa: رو‌لایه، ارتباط منطقی را روی زیرلایه می‌سازد.
rationale.de: Das Overlay schafft logische Verbindungen über dem Underlay.

text: A tunnel endpoint cannot reach the remote tunnel endpoint IP. Which layer should be checked first?

rationale.en: Tunnel endpoints require transport reachability.
rationale.fa: نقاط تونل به دسترسی در زیرلایه نیاز دارند.
rationale.de: Tunnelendpunkte benötigen Erreichbarkeit im Underlay.

text: An application requests network services from a controller. Which API direction normally describes this interaction?

rationale.en: Northbound interfaces connect applications to the controller.
rationale.fa: رابط شمالی، برنامه را به کنترلر وصل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Northbound-Schnittstellen verbinden Anwendungen mit dem Controller.

text: A controller communicates configuration to managed switches. Which API direction is this?

rationale.en: Southbound interfaces connect controllers to infrastructure.
rationale.fa: رابط جنوبی، کنترلر را به زیرساخت وصل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Southbound-Schnittstellen verbinden Controller mit Infrastruktur.

text: Which action belongs to the data plane?
options: Deciding a new campus access policy
Forwarding a packet using installed forwarding information

rationale.en: The data plane handles packet forwarding.
rationale.fa: صفحه داده، ارسال بسته‌ها را انجام می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Die Datenebene übernimmt die Paketweiterleitung.

text: A fabric carries separate tenant overlays over the same routed underlay. What does this allow?
options: Logical separation while sharing transport infrastructure
Identical access policy for every tenant

rationale.en: Overlays can isolate logical networks on shared transport.
rationale.fa: رو‌لایه‌ها می‌توانند شبکه‌های منطقی را روی انتقال مشترک جدا کنند.
rationale.de: Overlays trennen logische Netze auf gemeinsamem Transport.

text: A tool forecasts tomorrow's link utilization from historical counters. Which AI use is this?

rationale.en: Predictive models estimate future behavior from data.
rationale.fa: مدل پیش‌بین، رفتار آینده را از داده تخمین می‌زند.
rationale.de: Prädiktive Modelle schätzen künftiges Verhalten aus Daten.

text: A tool writes a proposed troubleshooting summary from supplied logs. Which capability is illustrated?

rationale.en: Generative AI produces new content from context.
rationale.fa: هوش مولد، محتوای جدید از زمینه می‌سازد.
rationale.de: Generative KI erzeugt neue Inhalte aus Kontext.

text: A model flags traffic that differs substantially from an established baseline. What is the likely use case?

rationale.en: Anomaly detection identifies departures from learned patterns.
rationale.fa: تشخیص ناهنجاری، تفاوت با الگوهای آموخته‌شده را پیدا می‌کند.
rationale.de: Anomalieerkennung identifiziert Abweichungen von erlernten Mustern.

text: A generated switch configuration contains unsupported commands. What is the appropriate response?
options: Validate against device documentation and test before deployment
Deploy it to all production devices immediately

rationale.en: Generated output can be incorrect and requires verification.
rationale.fa: خروجی مولد ممکن است غلط باشد و باید بررسی شود.
rationale.de: Generierte Ergebnisse können falsch sein und benötigen Prüfung.

text: Why does poor-quality training data reduce the usefulness of a network prediction model?
options: The model may learn misleading patterns

rationale.en: Model quality depends partly on representative, reliable data.
rationale.fa: کیفیت مدل به داده معتبر و نماینده وابسته است.
rationale.de: Modellqualität hängt von zuverlässigen, repräsentativen Daten ab.

text: An AI assistant requests complete configurations containing credentials. What should happen before sending them?
options: Publish all secrets for model accuracy
Remove secrets and follow approved data-handling rules

rationale.en: Sensitive data needs controlled handling.
rationale.fa: داده حساس باید طبق قواعد مجاز مدیریت شود.
rationale.de: Sensible Daten müssen kontrolliert verarbeitet werden.

text: How does machine learning differ from a fixed threshold such as CPU > 90%?
options: It operates only on optical interfaces
It requires no data at all
It can learn patterns from examples rather than relying only on one predefined rule

rationale.en: Learning uses data to identify patterns.
rationale.fa: یادگیری، الگوها را از داده استخراج می‌کند.
rationale.de: Lernen erkennt Muster anhand von Daten.

text: Which HTTP method normally retrieves a resource without requesting a state change?

rationale.en: GET requests a representation of a resource.
rationale.fa: GET نمایش یک منبع را درخواست می‌کند.
rationale.de: GET fordert eine Repräsentation einer Ressource an.

text: An API documents POST /devices as creating a device record. Which CRUD operation does it implement?

rationale.en: POST implements creation in this documented endpoint.
rationale.fa: در این نقطه، POST عملیات ایجاد را انجام می‌دهد.
rationale.de: POST führt hier die dokumentierte Erstellung aus.

text: An API documents PUT /devices/7 as replacing the resource. Which request best matches that contract?

rationale.en: PUT requests replacement of the target representation.
rationale.fa: PUT جایگزینی نمایش منبع هدف را درخواست می‌کند.
rationale.de: PUT fordert den Ersatz der Zielrepräsentation an.

text: Only the description of a device record must change. The API supports partial updates. Which method is most appropriate?

rationale.en: PATCH applies a partial modification.
rationale.fa: PATCH تغییر جزئی را اعمال می‌کند.
rationale.de: PATCH wendet eine Teiländerung an.

text: Which HTTP method requests removal of the target resource?

rationale.en: DELETE requests deletion of the target resource.
rationale.fa: DELETE حذف منبع هدف را درخواست می‌کند.
rationale.de: DELETE fordert die Löschung der Zielressource an.

text: An API returns HTTP 401 after a token expires. What should be checked first?
options: The OSPF cost to every destination

rationale.en: 401 indicates missing or invalid authentication.
rationale.fa: کد 401 نشان‌دهنده احراز هویت نامعتبر یا ناقص است.
rationale.de: 401 weist auf fehlende oder ungültige Authentifizierung hin.

text: A validly authenticated user receives HTTP 403 for a configuration endpoint. What is the likely problem?

rationale.en: 403 indicates the server refuses this access.
rationale.fa: کد 403 یعنی سرور این دسترسی را رد می‌کند.
rationale.de: 403 bedeutet, dass der Server diesen Zugriff verweigert.

text: A response has Content-Type: application/json. How should the body normally be interpreted?

rationale.en: Content-Type declares the representation format.
rationale.fa: Content-Type قالب داده را مشخص می‌کند.
rationale.de: Content-Type bezeichnet das Darstellungsformat.

text: A client must authenticate with an API key. Which practice protects the key in transit?
options: Use HTTPS and the API's documented authentication mechanism
Send it over plain HTTP on a trusted-looking URL
Embed it in a public repository
Share it in an unencrypted log

rationale.en: HTTPS protects transport; the API defines key placement.
rationale.fa: HTTPS انتقال را محافظت می‌کند؛ جای کلید را API تعیین می‌کند.
rationale.de: HTTPS schützt den Transport; die API definiert die Schlüsselübergabe.

text: What does stateless request handling mean in REST?
options: The server cannot store any resource data
Each request contains the context needed to process it

rationale.en: Statelessness concerns request context, not resource persistence.
rationale.fa: بی‌حالتی مربوط به زمینه درخواست است، نه ذخیره منابع.
rationale.de: Zustandslosigkeit betrifft Anfragekontext, nicht Ressourcenspeicherung.

text: The API returns HTTP 201 after a successful device creation. What does this status indicate?
options: The server could not be reached

rationale.en: 201 Created reports successful resource creation.
rationale.fa: کد 201 ایجاد موفق منبع را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: 201 Created meldet eine erfolgreiche Ressourcenerstellung.

text: An API returns HTTP 404 for /devcies/9 while /devices/9 exists. What should be corrected?

rationale.en: The misspelled URI targets an absent resource.
rationale.fa: آدرس غلط به منبع موجود اشاره نمی‌کند.
rationale.de: Der falsch geschriebene URI verweist auf keine vorhandene Ressource.

text: A client is sending excessive requests and receives HTTP 429. What is the appropriate behavior?
options: Reduce request rate and respect Retry-After when provided

rationale.en: 429 signals rate limiting.
rationale.fa: کد 429 محدودیت نرخ درخواست را نشان می‌دهد.
rationale.de: 429 signalisiert eine Begrenzung der Anfragerate.

text: Which property distinguishes an idempotent operation?
options: It must return an identical timestamp every time
Repeating the same request has the same intended effect as making it once
It always creates an additional resource

rationale.en: Idempotence describes the intended effect of repeated requests.
rationale.fa: هم‌توانی به اثر مورد انتظار درخواست تکراری مربوط است.
rationale.de: Idempotenz beschreibt die beabsichtigte Wirkung wiederholter Anfragen.

text: A client needs only response headers for a resource, without its representation body. Which HTTP method fits?

rationale.en: HEAD is like GET without the response body.
rationale.fa: HEAD مشابه GET است اما بدنه پاسخ ندارد.
rationale.de: HEAD entspricht GET ohne Antwortinhalt.

text: Which file commonly describes an ordered set of Ansible tasks?

rationale.en: Ansible playbooks define automation tasks in YAML.
rationale.fa: پلی‌بوک Ansible وظایف را با YAML تعریف می‌کند.
rationale.de: Ansible-Playbooks definieren Aufgaben in YAML.

text: An Ansible task should configure all routers in the branch group. Where is that target group normally defined?

rationale.en: Inventory identifies managed hosts and groups.
rationale.fa: فهرست موجودی، میزبان‌ها و گروه‌ها را مشخص می‌کند.
rationale.de: Das Inventar definiert verwaltete Hosts und Gruppen.

text: Which statement best describes Ansible's usual management model?
options: A mandatory proprietary agent on every switch
Agentless orchestration using supported remote connections or APIs

rationale.en: Ansible usually manages targets without a dedicated agent.
rationale.fa: Ansible معمولاً بدون عامل اختصاصی روی مقصد کار می‌کند.
rationale.de: Ansible verwaltet Ziele üblicherweise ohne eigenen Agenten.

text: An Ansible module sets a VLAN to its desired configuration on repeated runs. What is the desired behavior?
options: Creating duplicate VLANs on each run
No additional change once the desired state already exists

rationale.en: Idempotent tasks avoid unnecessary repeated changes.
rationale.fa: وظایف هم‌توان از تغییر تکراری غیرضروری جلوگیری می‌کنند.
rationale.de: Idempotente Aufgaben vermeiden unnötige Wiederholungsänderungen.

text: What is the main purpose of Terraform?
options: Declare and manage infrastructure resources through providers

rationale.en: Terraform manages infrastructure as code.
rationale.fa: Terraform زیرساخت را به صورت کد مدیریت می‌کند.
rationale.de: Terraform verwaltet Infrastruktur als Code.

text: An engineer wants to preview Terraform's proposed resource changes before applying them. Which command is appropriate?
options: terraform fmt as a deployment command

rationale.en: Plan previews the changes Terraform proposes.
rationale.fa: Plan تغییرات پیشنهادی Terraform را نمایش می‌دهد.
rationale.de: Plan zeigt die vorgeschlagenen Terraform-Änderungen.

text: What does a Terraform provider supply?
options: Integration with a platform's resource APIs

rationale.en: Providers connect Terraform to target platform APIs.
rationale.fa: ارائه‌دهنده، Terraform را به API پلتفرم وصل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Provider verbinden Terraform mit Plattform-APIs.

text: A Terraform state file contains sensitive resource values. How should it be handled?
options: Publish it in a public repository
Store it with controlled access and appropriate protection

rationale.en: State can contain sensitive infrastructure data.
rationale.fa: فایل وضعیت ممکن است داده حساس زیرساخت داشته باشد.
rationale.de: State kann sensible Infrastrukturdaten enthalten.

text: In {"hostname":"R1","enabled":true}, what type is the value of enabled?

rationale.en: Unquoted true is a JSON boolean.
rationale.fa: true بدون نقل‌قول، مقدار بولی JSON است.
rationale.de: Unquotiertes true ist ein JSON-Boolean.

text: Which JSON fragment is valid?

rationale.en: JSON object keys require double quotes; trailing commas are invalid.
rationale.fa: کلید JSON نقل‌قول دوتایی می‌خواهد؛ ویرگول آخر مجاز نیست.
rationale.de: JSON-Schlüssel benötigen doppelte Anführungszeichen; Schlusskommas sind ungültig.

text: What does the value in {"interfaces":["Gi0/1","Gi0/2"]} represent?

rationale.en: Square brackets enclose an array.
rationale.fa: براکت مربعی، آرایه را مشخص می‌کند.
rationale.de: Eckige Klammern kennzeichnen ein Array.

text: Given {"device":{"name":"R2","ports":4}}, how many keys are in the nested device object?

rationale.en: The nested object contains name and ports.
rationale.fa: شیء داخلی دو کلید name و ports دارد.
rationale.de: Das verschachtelte Objekt enthält name und ports.

text: A JSON parser rejects {"up":True}. What fixes it?
options: Put the entire object in single quotes

rationale.en: JSON boolean literals are lowercase true and false.
rationale.fa: مقادیر بولی JSON با حروف کوچک نوشته می‌شوند.
rationale.de: JSON-Boolean-Literale lauten kleingeschrieben true und false.

text: In {"count":"12"}, what is the type of count?

rationale.en: Quotes make 12 a string rather than a number.
rationale.fa: نقل‌قول، 12 را به رشته تبدیل می‌کند.
rationale.de: Anführungszeichen machen 12 zu einer Zeichenkette.

text: Which JSON value explicitly represents the absence of a value?

rationale.en: JSON defines null, not undefined or None.
rationale.fa: JSON مقدار null دارد، نه undefined یا None.
rationale.de: JSON definiert null, nicht undefined oder None.

text: Which JSON document has an array as its outermost value?

rationale.en: The outer square brackets create a top-level array.
rationale.fa: براکت‌های بیرونی، آرایه سطح بالا می‌سازند.
rationale.de: Die äußeren eckigen Klammern erzeugen ein oberstes Array.

text: A developer adds // router comment inside a JSON document. Why does a strict parser reject it?
options: JSON requires every value to be a string

rationale.en: Standard JSON has no comment syntax.
rationale.fa: JSON استاندارد، دستور توضیح ندارد.
rationale.de: Standard-JSON enthält keine Kommentarsyntax.
